input: Krasinski Square is a square located in the center of Warsaw, the capital of Poland. This square is famous for its numerous historical buildings. The history of the square dates back to the late 18th century.

The Worms Cathedral (German: Wormser Dom) is located in Worms, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. It is a 12th-century Romanesque building, built between 1171 and 1234, and is a sandstone building with a polygonal plan. It is a famous relic in the Rhine River Basin.

The old site of Puji Hospital is located at No. 1 Jiaozhou Road, Shibei District, Qingdao City, Shandong Province, China. It was built in 1919 and is one of the few public buildings built during the first Japanese occupation period that still exist in the old city of Qingdao. It is now used by the headquarters of Qingdao Municipal Hospital.

input: People's Square, located in Haigang District, Qinhuangdao City, Hebei Province, is a landmark building of Qinhuangdao City.

The Křivoklát Castle is a castle located in the town of Křivoklát in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. This castle was built in the 12th century and belonged to the Bohemian king. The castle has experienced many fires in history. Now this castle is a museum.

The Jeya Reservoir  is a large reservoir in Russia, located on the Jeya River next to the city of Jeya in the Amur State north of the border with China. It was completed in 1972, with the water depth controlled at 93 meters. It is the largest hydroelectric power plant in eastern Siberia, and the Baikal-Amur Mainline passes through the north bank.

The Yubileiny Sports Palace is a stadium in Saint Petersburg, Russia, which can also be used to host concerts and other events. The Yubileiny Sports Palace can accommodate more than 7,000 spectators, mainly hosting ice hockey and basketball games.
The Stuhlmannbrunnen, a fountain in Hamburg, Germany, is located in the Republic Square of the Altona district and was built in 1900. It was designed by Paul Türpe and is a cultural heritage.
Fairfax Bridge (English: Fairfax Bridge) is a deck arch bridge in Pierce County, Washington State, carrying Washington State Route 165.

The Cathedral of Siguenza is a Roman Catholic cathedral in the Spanish city of Siguenza, with a Roman and Gothic exterior. This cathedral is also the cathedral of the Catholic Diocese of Siguenza-Guadalajara. The cathedral was built in 1121.

Peacock Island Palace  is a palace building on the Havel River in Berlin, Germany, with a romantic style exterior. This building was built in 1797 during the reign of Frederick William II. Now this palace is a museum.

The Guanzhong Folk Art Museum is a folk museum located in Chang'an District, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province. The museum covers an area of 493.88 acres and has a planned building area of 108,000 square meters, which was funded and built by Wang Yongchao. The museum has relocated more than 40 Ming and Qing ancient folk houses from different places in the Guanzhong area to the museum, and at the same time, more than 8600 horse stakes from various dynasties have been moved here.

Panzhihua Bao'anying Airport  is located in the southeastern part of Panzhihua City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, on the top of the mountain where Yijiang Town in the East District and Jinjiang Town in Renhe District meet. The runway is 1976 meters above sea level, with a relative height difference of about one kilometer from the Jinsha River at the foot of the mountain. The air distance is 537 kilometers from Chengdu, 193 kilometers from Kunming, 173 kilometers from Dali, 155 kilometers from Lijiang, and 165 kilometers from Xichang. The flight area level is 4C, the runway length is 2800 meters, and there are 4 apron positions, which can take off and land Boeing 737, Airbus A320 and other models.

Jin'ao Yuyu Bridge, originally named Jinhai Bridge, also known as Yuhe Bridge, commonly known as Beihai Bridge, is located between Beihai Park in Xicheng District, Beijing and Zhongnanhai. The bridge is Wenjin Street.

input: The Post Office Headquarters Building is a structure in Belgrade, the capital of Serbia, near the Serbian Parliament Building, the Serbian Presidential Palace , and the Old Palace. This building is not only the center of Serbian postal services, but also one of the most representative buildings in Belgrade.

The Thuwunna Youth Training Centre Stadium is a comprehensive sports stadium located in Yangon, Myanmar, with 32,000 seats. It is smaller but newer than the Aung San Stadium. Both domestic and international football and track and field events are primarily held at the Thuwunna Stadium.

In order to accommodate the large crowds that flood in whenever there are sports events, rallies or concerts at the Stadium Merdeka and the National Stadium nearby, but the station is not used much on normal days. This station is also one of the closest to Jalan Petaling, with many tourist attractions in the old city area of Kuala Lumpur nearby. In the future, this station will be connected to Merdeka 118.

Shengli Farm is a farm located in Raohe County, Shuangyashan City, Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China, and is also a farm under the jurisdiction of the Heilongjiang Provincial Agricultural Reclamation Bureau. The total area of Shengli Farm is 922 square kilometers, the cultivated land area is 693,000 mu, and the total population is 23,000.

Gaillon Square  is a square in the northwest of the second district of Paris, France, roughly trapezoidal, about 25 meters long and about 15 meters wide. The west side of the square is Port-Mahon Street , the east side is Michaudier Street, the east-west road on the south side of the square is Saint-Augustin Street , and the north side of the square is a building. To the south of the square is Gaillon Street .
The Guiren Stadium is a stadium located in Guiren City, Pingding Province, Vietnam.

The Seventh Grandfather Mansion, also known as the Fu Xiang Grandfather Mansion, is located in Harlamodu Town, Qian Guo County, Jilin Province, China. It is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit, classified as an ancient building, and was announced on May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Qian Guo County Cultural Management Office. The historical era of the Seventh Grandfather Mansion is the Qing Dynasty.

Phoenix Snow Park is a ski resort located in Bongpyeong-myeon, Pyeongchang County, South Korea. The freestyle skiing and snowboarding competitions of the 2018 Winter Olympics were held here. It can accommodate 18,000 people. It is one of the filming locations of the TV drama "Blue Love and Death".
Tokyo Sankei Building is a skyscraper located in Otemachi, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, and its current owner is Sankei Building Co., Ltd.

The Royal Cinque Ports Golf Club is an 18-hole links golf course located in Deal, Kent, in the southeast of England, UK. The course was established in 1892 and hosted the British Open Golf Championship twice in 1909 and 1920.

The Jiangling Olympic Park is a sports park located in Jiangling City, where 4 competition venues of the 2018 Winter Olympics are located. It will serve as an Olympic Park. It includes the following venues:

The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes is a place of pilgrimage for the Catholic Church to pay homage to Our Lady of Lourdes, located in Lourdes, France. It includes the Massabielle Grotto, the nearby spring flowing with Lourdes holy water, the office of the Lourdes Medical Bureau, and several churches and papal basilicas such as the Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary, and the Basilica of St. Pius X. It covers an area of 51 hectares and includes 22 different places of worship. The sanctuary has six official languages: French, English, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, and German.

The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes

input: Heiwa Island Park is a park located in Heiwa Island, Ota District, Tokyo, Japan. It has a baseball field and swimming pools , and a square where barbecue activities can be held.

Xiaodongying Mosque is a mosque in Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, China. It is one of the five major mosques in Guangzhou, located in Yuexiu District, Yuehua Road, Xiaodongying. The former site of the "March 29th" Uprising Command is nearby.

The Kuala Lumpur International Airport Station  is located at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia, and was opened for operation on June 10, 2002, along with the Kuala Lumpur Airport Express .

The Ikejima Bridge is a bridge located in the northwest of Miyakojima City, Okinawa Prefecture. The Ikejima Bridge is 1,425 meters long and connects Miyakojima and Ikejima. The bridge was opened to traffic in February 1992, and before the completion of the Kojima Bridge in March 1995, it was the longest bridge in Okinawa Prefecture.

Kasungu National Park is a national park in the western part of Malawi, located in the western part of Kasungu, about 175 kilometers from the capital of Malawi, Lilongwe. The national park extends to the border of Zambia. Kasungu National Park was established in 1970, with a protected area of 2,316 square kilometers. It is the second largest national park in Malawi, with an average altitude of over 1,000 meters.

The Qiqihar Fourth Hospital, now known as the Qiqihar Union Hospital, is located at No. 28, Yumin 1st Street, Jianhua District. In 2007, the municipal office attracted investment, with a total investment of 16 million yuan from foreign merchants, and the newly built Qiqihar Union Hospital. However, this hospital has no relation with the Beijing Union Hospital.
The National Monument  is a monument located on Dam Square in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

The Church of Saint Teresa and Saint Joseph, also known as the Church of Saint Teresa and the Barefoot Carmelite Monastery, is a Roman Catholic church in Madrid, Spain. It was declared a Spanish cultural property in 1995.

input: Chen Shili Bridge, officially known as Ruan Wen Zhui-Chen Shili Bridge, is a bridge located in Da Nang, Vietnam, spanning the Han River. This bridge replaced two old bridges named after Ruan Wen Zhui and Chen Shili.

The Burrard Bridge (English: Burrard Bridge) is a truss bridge in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, crossing the west end of False Creek and connecting downtown Vancouver and Kitsilano. The bridge currently has five lanes, running through Burrard Street on both sides, and pedestrian and bicycle lanes are set on both sides of the lanes. The Art Deco style of the bridge makes it one of the main landmarks in Vancouver.
The ancient Hsiya Mosque is a mosque in Wazirpur Upazila, Barisal City, Barisal Division, Bangladesh.

Akiba Shrine, the main shrine of Akiba Mountain, is located near the top of Akiba Mountain in Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The old shrine was a county shrine . It is the origin shrine of all Akiba shrines in Japan , Akiba Daiken and Akiba Temple.

relation.head: Akiba Shrine
relation.tail: near the top of Akiba Mountain

input: The Cangshan Stone Buddha Hall, located in Cangshan, Baoding City, Hebei Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit in Fuping County, Baoding City. The type is a stone cave temple, and the announcement time is July 23, 1982. The historical era of the Cangshan Stone Buddha Hall is the Ming Dynasty.

Wenxiakou Reservoir is located in Zhongxiang City, Hubei Province, China. It is a large  type reservoir with the main functions of irrigation and flood control, and also has functions such as power generation and aquaculture. In 2008, it was listed as a national water conservancy scenic spot by the Ministry of Water Resources under the name of "Zhongxiang Wenxia Lake Water Conservancy Scenic Area".

relation.tail: Zhongxiang Wenxia Lake Water Conservancy Scenic Area

input: Shandong International Financial Center is a skyscraper under construction in Jinan, Shandong Province, China. The construction started in 2018 and topped out in 2022. The building is 428 meters high and has 88 floors. It is expected to become the tallest building in Jinan after its completion in 2023.

The Taichung Longjing Solar Power Plant is located in Longjing District, Taichung City, Taiwan, and is a ground-based solar power plant built by Taiwan Power Company. This power plant is one of the sub-projects in the "First Phase of Solar Power Plan" promoted by Taiwan Power Company.

The Wordless Stele, also known as the Monument, is located on the east side of the Tang Qian Mausoleum in Qian County, Shaanxi. It was erected by the Wu Zhou Emperor Wu Zetian and corresponds to the Shu Sheng Ji Stele of Tang Gaozong Li Zhi on the west side. The Wordless Stele is carved from a single piece of stone, weighing 98.8 tons, and is a giant among the tombstones of all ages in China.

Djerdap National Park is a national park in Serbia, covering the area from the right bank of the Danube River from Golubac Fortress to Novi Sad. This national park was established in 1974, with an area of 63,786.5 ha (157,620 acres).
Pipa Mountain Park is an urban park located on Zhongshan Second Road in Yuzhong District, Chongqing City. The mountain is 345 meters high, which is the highest point in Yuzhong District.

The Poznan Royal Castle is a castle located in the Polish city of Poznan. The history of this castle can be traced back to 1249. During the Second World War, the castle was severely damaged, but it has now been partially rebuilt.

The Garabit Viaduct  is a railway viaduct located in the Cantal department near Ruynes-en-Margeride, France, spanning the Truyère river. The bridge is located in the Central Massif region of France. The viaduct was designed by Gustave Eiffel and built between 1882 and 1884, with Maurice Koechlin serving as the structural engineer. It was opened in 1885. The bridge is 565 meters  long, with a main span of 165 meters .

relation.head: The Garabit Viaduct
relation.tail: the Central Massif region of France

input: The Hangzhou Mosque is located in the Shangcheng District of Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China, and is an Islamic-style mosque. The Hangzhou Mosque is one of the largest mosques in China. The Hangzhou Islamic Association is also set up in the mosque.

Port of Spain  is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago, located on the western side of Trinidad Island by the Paria Bay. The population of Port of Spain is about 350,000, making it the third most populous city in the country, only after Chaguanas and San Fernando.

relation.tail: the western side of Trinidad Island by the Paria Bay

input: Stallbron  is an arch bridge located in the old town center of Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Stallbron is one of the oldest bridges in Stockholm's history, originally built in the 18th century. The current Stallbron is a single-arch steel bridge, completed in 1904.

relation.head: Stallbron
relation.tail: the old town center of Stockholm

input: Xishan Temple, is a Northern Emperor Temple located in Guangzhou, Guangdong, at the first Jin grass field in the west of the city, which was established in the Ming Dynasty. It once joined other local temples to establish a charity hall, which no longer exists today.

The Hallwyl Museum  is a museum in Sweden, located in the center of Stockholm. The building of the Hallwyl Museum was built from 1893 to 1898, once belonged to the Count and Countess of Hallwyl, but was donated to the Swedish government in 1920. The museum opened in 1938.

Kogen-ji is a temple of the Rinzai sect, Yuanjue Temple faction, located in Gyoda City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name is Tenshinzan, and the main deity worshipped is Amitabha Tathagata.
Anyang is currently planning to build the Anyang Northeast Henan Airport in Wagang Township, Tangyin County, which is designed as a civil feeder airport, about 28 kilometers from the city.

The Wawel Royal Castle is a medieval castle located in Wawel, Poland. This castle was built by Casimir III the Great from 1357 to 1370, originally as a defensive fortification. During World War II, the castle was severely damaged and has been under reconstruction since 1964.

The Stonewall Library & Archives is a private library located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA, dedicated to collecting historical documents or related publications related to lesbians, gays, bisexuals, and transgender people. The Stonewall Library & Archives has over 18,000 books, films, and DVDs open to the public, making it the library with the largest collection of LGBT artifacts in the southeastern United States.

Dengying Bridge, located in Dulin Village, Cangzhou City, Hebei Province, China, is a national key cultural relics protection unit in Cang County. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is May 2013. The historical era of Dengying Bridge is the Ming Dynasty.

Grodno Castle, also known as Grodno Castle, is a castle in Poland, located in the south of Poland. Grodno Castle was built in 1193 by Duke Bolesław. The castle was once part of the defensive line between the Duchy of Jawor and the Kingdom of Bohemia.

Fengshan Theater, located in Fengshan Town, Chengde City, Hebei Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relics protection unit in Fengning Manchu Autonomous County of Chengde City. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is July 23, 1982. The historical era of Fengshan Theater is the Qing Dynasty.

Hans-Albers-Platz is a square in Hamburg, Germany, located in the St. Pauli district. It is named after the actor and singer Hans Albers and is a famous spot within the red-light district of Rope Street.

The Roman Theatre is an ancient Roman-era theatre in the city of Cartagena, in the autonomous region of Murcia, Spain. The Roman Theatre was built between 5 BC and the 1st century. In the 3rd century, a market was built on the original site of the theatre.

The Jingshan Alpine Skiing Center is a high mountain ski resort located on the Gariwang Mountain in Jingshan County, Gangwon Province, South Korea. Jingshan was the competition venue for the 2018 Winter Olympics, where alpine skiing, super giant slalom, and mixed skiing were held. The venue can accommodate 6500 people.
The Durdevica Tara Bridge is a concrete arch bridge located in the northern part of Montenegro on the Tara River.

Yankee Stadium (English: Yankee Stadium) is a baseball stadium located in the Bronx, New York City, New York State, USA. It is the home field of the New York Yankees of the Major League Baseball. It replaced the old Yankee Stadium that was opened in 1923. The new and old stadiums are only separated by a street, and the location is at the former site of Macombs Dam Park. The new Yankee Stadium was opened on April 4, 2009, and the opening game held on April 16 of the same year was a match between the Yankees and the Cleveland Indians.

The Chongqing Central Park project was launched in May 2011, construction officially started in June 2011, with a total investment of about 4.6 billion yuan. It was opened to the public in January 2013, and is one of the larger urban parks in China. When completed, it was the largest open urban park in western China.

Dongguang Temple, a Shingon sect of Toyama temple located in Nakano, Hunan Town, Koriyama City, Fukushima Prefecture. It is famous for having the largest wooden statue of Amitabha Buddha in Northeast Japan, "Nakaji Daibutsu".

input: The New Castle is a castle located in the Slovak town of Banska Stiavnica. This castle is situated on a small hill in the southern part of the city center of Banska Stiavnica, with an altitude of 630 meters, which is also the highest point in the city center. Now this castle is a museum.

The Old Baeza Cathedral (Spanish: Catedral de Baeza) is a Roman Catholic church in the city of Baeza in the autonomous region of Andalusia in southern Spain. The church was once the cathedral of the Baeza diocese. The church is also listed as a World Heritage Site.

Penghu Airport, is a military-civilian airport located in Aimen Village, Huxi Township, Penghu County, Taiwan. It is the main external airport of Penghu County, formerly known as "Magong Airport". The civilian part is managed and operated by the Magong Aviation Station of the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transport; the military part is the Air Force Magong Base.

The Governor Nobre de Carvalho Bridge (Portuguese: Ponte Governador Nobre de Carvalho; also known as the Governor Nobre de Carvalho Bridge, commonly known as the Macau-Taipa Bridge, Macau Cross-sea Bridge, Old Macau-Taipa Bridge, Old Bridge or Old Bridge) is the first cross-sea bridge in Macau connecting the Macau Peninsula and Taipa. It is also one of the "Top Ten Construction Projects" in Portugal at that time. The bridge starts from the coast opposite the Lisboa Hotel on the Macau Peninsula and ends at the northern foot of Taipa's Little Tam Mountain.

input: Oku-Aizu Reservoir is a reservoir located in Hinoemata Village, Minamiaizu District, Fukushima Prefecture, and Uonuma City, Niigata Prefecture, Japan, belonging to the Agano River basin. The dam height of this reservoir ranks fifth in Japan and is also the highest gravity dam in Japan. Oku-Aizu Reservoir is also part of the Echigo Sanzan Tadami Quasi-National Park.

The Panemune Castle is a castle building in Lithuania, located on the right bank of the Nemunas River in the Jurbarkas district. This castle was built in the early 17th century, and its construction purpose was not for military purposes but for noble residences. This castle is also one of the most beautiful Renaissance buildings in Lithuania.

relation.tail: the right bank of the Nemunas River

input: Hengfeng Road Overpass is a cable-stayed bridge spanning the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway in Jing'an District, Shanghai, People's Republic of China. It is also the country's first prestressed concrete single-tower single-cable harp-style cable-stayed bridge. It is located west of Shanghai Railway Station. The total length is 630 meters. The bridge runs from north to south, connecting Hengfeng North Road in the north and Hengfeng Road in the south. It was completed and opened to traffic on September 30, 1987.

Huanhua Creek Park is located at No. 9 Qinghua Road, Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, connecting to Du Fu Thatched Cottage in the north and Sichuan Provincial Museum in the east. It is the only five-star park in Chengdu.

Beijing Amusement Park, located at No. 19, Zuo'anmen Inner Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (originally belonged to Chongwen District, which merged with Dongcheng District in 2010 to form the new Dongcheng District), is a large amusement park. It was closed in 2010 and reopened on September 24, 2021, under the name of Longtan Zhonghu Park, becoming a free park.

Xiajiasi Reservoir, located in Huangpi District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, China, is a large  type reservoir with the main functions of irrigation and flood prevention, and also considers tourism, aquaculture, power generation and other functions. Because it is located in the territory of Mulan Township on the east side of Mulan Mountain, it is also called Mulan Lake. In 2007, it was approved by the Ministry of Water Resources as the seventh batch of national water conservancy scenic spots.

input: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Calbayog (Latin: Dioecesis Calbayoganus, Tagalog: Diyosesis ng Calbayog) is a diocese of the Roman Catholic Church in the Philippines, belonging to the Archdiocese of Palo. Its jurisdiction includes the province of Western Samar. It was elevated to a diocese on April 12, 1910. In 2006, it had 668,000 parishioners, 27 parishes, and 65 priests. The current bishop is Isabella Avarquez. The cathedral is the Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul, located in the capital of Western Samar, Calbayog.

input: The Berlin Radio Tower (German: Berliner Funkturm) is a former broadcasting tower in Berlin. It was built between 1924 and 1926, designed by architect Heinrich Straumer, and was declared completed on September 3, 1926, at the third Great German Radio Exhibition. It is located in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf in the center of Berlin. This tower, nicknamed "Skinny Guy" (der lange Lulatsch), is one of the most famous attractions in Berlin. Although it is no longer used for broadcasting purposes, it is still a protected monument.
Maki Station is a station located in Maki, Eiichiracho, Hashima City, Gifu Prefecture, on the Nagoya Railway  Takeguchi Line .

The Red Church is a former Protestant church in Olomouc, Czech Republic. This church was built by German architect Max Löwe from 1901 to 1902 for the local German-speaking Bohemians, Moravians, and Silesians of the German Evangelical Church. After the Second World War, the Germans were expelled, and the church was handed over to the Czech Protestants. In 1959, it was given to the university library.

The Church of Water is a small chapel located in the Hoshino TOMAMU Resort on a mountain in Shimukappu Village, Yufutsu District, in the center of Hokkaido, Japan. It was designed by architect Tadao Ando in 1985, built with fair-faced concrete, and completed in 1988. Together with the "Church of Wind" and the "Church of Light", they are collectively referred to as "Tadao Ando's Trilogy of Churches".

Huizhou Jinshan Bridge, located in Huicheng District, Huizhou City, Guangdong Province, China, is a highway bridge spanning the Xinkai River and the West Branch River. The construction of the bridge started on April 13, 2007. On July 13, 2009, the Jinshan Bridge, which had been under construction for more than two years, was completed, and it officially opened to traffic on September 30. The Jinshan Bridge is divided into the South Bridge and the North Bridge with Wentou Ridge as the boundary. The main line of the South Bridge is a two-way eight-lane road with a width of 45.5 meters, while the main line of the North Bridge is a two-way six-lane road with a width of 31.5 meters. The total length of the bridge is 2850 meters. At the time of its completion, it was the largest and longest-spanning mega bridge in Huizhou City, costing 360 million RMB.

input: The Salvation Church is an ancient Christian church in Wuhan, China, which combines Chinese and Western styles. The Salvation Church is located on Han Zheng Street in Qiaokou District, adjacent to the earliest Western hospital in Wuhan, the Universal Love Hospital. It was built by the British Methodist missionary Guo Xiuli in 1867, rebuilt in 1931, with upturned eaves and can accommodate nearly a thousand people. It is the central church of the Methodist Church. In 1958, a joint worship was implemented, and the Salvation Church was able to continue to be preserved until the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution in 1966. Worship was resumed in the 1980s. It is listed as an excellent historical building in Wuhan.

Chongqing Garden Expo Park is a city park located in the Longjing Lake area of Liangjiang New District in Chongqing City, with the address of No.1 Longjing Road, Yuanyang Street, Yubei District. The park covers an area of 3300 mu, including a water area of 800 mu. It is a landmark garden public facility in Chongqing with a total investment of 1.48 billion yuan.

The Temple of San Miguel is a Baroque-style Roman Catholic Papal Basilica located in the center of Madrid, Spain. It is located on Calle de San Justo, adjacent to the Archbishop's Palace. It is the church of the Papal Nuncio in Spain, now managed by the Fathers of the Main Business.

The most important Renaissance building in Mainz is the Electoral Palace, which is a representative building of the so-called "German Renaissance" in its later period. Other Renaissance buildings include today's Gutenberg Museum and the French Research Institute. The "Market Fountain" is the most luxurious Renaissance fountain in Germany. Another building from the transition period between the Renaissance and Baroque is the Old University Main Building, which was built in 1615. For centuries, it has been the tallest civil building in Mainz.

Wenshan Yanshan Airport  is a civil airport located in Yanshan County, Wenshan Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China. It is 9 kilometers away from Yanshan County and 28 kilometers away from Wenshan City, the capital of the prefecture. The airport's flight area is rated as 4C, with a runway length of 2400 meters and a width of 45 meters. The main landing direction of the runway is Category I precision approach, and the secondary landing direction is light approach system. In 2015, the passenger throughput exceeded 100,000. It is the stationed training base for several civil aviation companies. The airport is affiliated with Yunnan Airport Group Co., Ltd.

Siyuan Bridge is a large overpass located in Chaoyang District, Beijing, China, in the northeastern part of Beijing. It connects the Fourth Ring Road and National Highway 101 , and the Beijing Airport Expressway, making it an important hub-type overpass. Siyuan Bridge won the Luban Award for the year 1995.

The Market Street Bridge is a major bridge on Market Street, a main east-west thoroughfare in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States, spanning the Schuylkill River. The current bridge is the fifth permanent bridge built in this area.

Mariinsky Park is a park in the center of Kiev, the capital of Ukraine, located at the intersection of Constitution Square, Grushevsky Street, and Park Road. The park has a history of about 130 years.

input: Lì Miào Bridge, also translated as Dì Miào Bridge, is a cable-stayed bridge in the Mekong Delta region of Vietnam. The bridge connects Meiqiu City in Qianjiang Province and Zhoucheng County in Bingzhan Province.

Pieskowa Skała Castle is a castle in Poland, located 35 kilometers north of Krakow. The castle is built on a limestone cliff and is a Renaissance-style building, which is included in the Ojców National Park. The castle was built during the reign of Casimir III.

input: The Carrousel Bridge  is a bridge in Paris, France, spanning the Seine River, connecting the Tuileries Quay and the Voltaire Quay, near the Palais-Royal Louvre station. Because it is close to the Louvre, this bridge is also known as the Louvre Bridge.

The Cavenagh Bridge was inaugurated in 1869 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the opening of Singapore. The bridge was named after Sir William O. Cavenagh, the last governor of the Straits Settlements from 1859 to 1867. This bridge is the oldest existing suspension bridge on the Singapore River. In August 2019, which was also the 200th anniversary of the opening of the port, the Singapore government announced that this suspension bridge would be listed as one of the national monuments.

Pet birds may vent their emotions through feather plucking behavior. Observations have found that feather plucking may be due to birds feeling neglected, sad, and even when they are joyful, birds may also pluck feathers. The solid, liquid, or gaseous clumps that cause obstruction are called emboli. Embolism is different from thrombosis, the latter is the blood flow obstruction caused by thrombus at its formation site. Thromboembolism caused by the detachment of thrombus emboli is the most common type of embolism. Fat droplets, bone marrow, air, atherosclerotic fragments, tumor tissues, amniotic fluid, etc. may also cause embolism. input: Terbium tetrafluoride is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula TbF4. It is a white crystal and a strong oxidizer. It can be obtained by reacting high-purity terbium trifluoride with xenon difluoride, chlorine trifluoride, or fluorine gas.

Gadolinium acetate is a salt formed by the lanthanide metal gadolinium and acetic acid, with the chemical formula Gd3. It is a colorless crystal that is soluble in water and can form hydrates. Its tetrahydrate has basic ferromagnetism.

relation.head: lanthanide metal gadolinium and acetic acid

input: Ceftobiprole , the fifth-generation cephalosporin used for community-acquired pneumonia, was developed by the University of Lausanne Medical School and Basilea Pharmaceutica in 2002, with the initial code name BAL9141. In 2008, Ceftobiprole was first launched globally in Canada in the form of injections by Janssen Pharmaceuticals of Belgium.
Citral, also known as "3,7-Dimethyl-2,6-octadienal", with the chemical formula C10H16O, is an unsaturated aldehyde monoterpenoid with two double bonds.

Hydrogen gallium reacts with fluorine, burns and forms gallium fluoride and hydrogen fluoride. The reaction is similar to chlorine, but if the reaction is not complete, green complex salt will be left. The reaction of hydrogen gallium with bromine or iodine is not intense.

Silver phosphate precipitate not only has an important position in analytical chemistry, but it is also used in silver staining of biological materials  - as an indicator of phosphates. In early photography, silver phosphate was also found to be used as a photosensitizer. In 2010, there were reports that as a photocatalyst for the decomposition of water in visible light, silver phosphate has a high quantum yield , and can also be used to produce reactive oxygen in the same way. Silver phosphate is also a potential material that can add the antibacterial properties of silver ions to other materials.

The unit of electric energy is "joule", abbreviated as "joule", represented by the Latin letter J. Electric energy is equal to the integral of active power over time. Because the unit joule is very small and inconvenient to use in life and production, people use a larger energy unit than joule - kilowatt-hour , the symbol of kilowatt is kW·h. The conversion formula between the unit joule of electric energy and kilowatt-hour is: 1 kilowatt-hour = 3.6×106 joules.

The main components of wood vinegar are acetic acid, acetone, and methanol. It has been used as a commercial source of acetic acid. In addition, wood vinegar usually contains 80-90% water and about 200 kinds of organic compounds.

Clams are rich in protein, calcium, phosphorus, sodium, potassium, zinc, a small amount of taurine, vitamins and other ingredients. The "Newly Revised Materia Medica" compiled by Su Jing and others during the Tang Dynasty mentioned:

It can be obtained by the reaction of praseodymium hexaoxide and fluorine gas under ultraviolet irradiation in anhydrous hydrogen fluoride. It can also be obtained by the reaction of praseodymium trifluoride or praseodymium hexaoxide with krypton difluoride, with an oxide yield of up to 100%. Another method is to obtain Na2PrF6 by fluorinating Na2PrCl5, which decomposes in anhydrous hydrogen fluoride to obtain praseodymium tetrafluoride.

Electrical energy refers to the ability of electricity to do work in various forms . Electrical energy can be conveniently and efficiently converted into mechanical energy, thermal energy, chemical energy, light energy, sound energy, and magnetic energy. Electrical energy is widely used in various fields such as power, lighting, metallurgy, chemistry, textiles, communications, broadcasting, etc., and is the main driving force for the development of science and technology and the leap of the national economy.
The LD50 of methylamine  is 2400mg/m3. Methylamine is also a Schedule I compound listed by the Drug Enforcement Administration  in the United States .

Aminosulfonic acid is a colorless crystal, its aqueous solution is acidic, and its chemical formula is H3NSO3. The melting point is 205°C, it can be dissolved in liquid nitrogen, ethanol, formamide, acetone, slightly soluble in methanol, and difficult to dissolve in ether.

Common emulsifiers include: surfactants, those with a high oil-water balance coefficient, suitable for preparing water-in-oil emulsions; those with a low oil-water balance coefficient, suitable for preparing oil-in-water emulsions; natural emulsifiers are mostly hydrophilic gums, which can increase the viscosity of the continuous phase, enhance the stability of the emulsion, and are suitable for preparing water-in-oil emulsions, solid particle emulsions, and auxiliary emulsifiers.

Hydrogen sulfide is generally formed by separating acid gas, that is, natural gas with a large amount of H2S. It can also be formed by the combination of hydrogen and liquid sulfur at 450°C. Hydrocarbons can be used as the source of hydrogen in the reaction. It is generally used in the laboratory.

Phosphorus trisulfide, with the chemical formula P4S3, appears as a yellow solid and is one of the two methods used in industry to produce phosphorus pentoxide. Depending on the purity, the sample can present different colors from yellow-green to gray. Phosphorus trisulfide was first discovered by G.Lemoine, and its industrial production method was developed and produced in the Olbricht and Wilson laboratories in 1898. It dissolves in carbon disulfide of equal mass. Unlike other phosphorus sulfides, the hydrolysis of phosphorus trisulfide is slow and has a definite melting point.
3β-Androstanediol is an endogenous steroid hormone with strong estrogenic activity. 3β-Androstanediol can be converted from dehydroepiandrosterone by 5α-reductase 17β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase.

Tetrakisphosphonium chloride  is an organic phosphorus compound, a quaternary phosphonium salt, with the chemical formula [P4]Cl. It consists of four-coordinate P4+ and Cl−. It is mainly used as a fire retardant and a bactericide for commercial or industrial water systems.
Dansyl chloride, also known as "5-naphthalene-1-sulfonyl chloride" or dansyl, is a reagent used for the determination of amines and the N-terminal amino acids of proteins/peptides.

relation.tail: a reagent used for the determination of amines and the N-terminal amino acids of proteins/peptides

input: Pyrrolidine, also known as Tetrahydropyrrole, is a five-membered nitrogen-containing saturated heterocyclic compound.

Acrylic resin is a group of thermoplastic or thermosetting plastic materials derived from acrylic acid. Methyl acrylic acid or other related compounds polymerize to form polymethyl acrylate, which can be used in acrylic resin paint, textile finishing agents, adhesives, bonding with clay, and correcting paper errors. Another type of acrylic resin is polymethyl methacrylate, which is used to improve the transparency of various hard plastics.

Animal Morphology, a branch of zoology, studies the morphological structure of animals and their changes in the process of individual development and systematic evolution. The scope is very wide, which can be divided into several disciplines: including anatomy, comparative anatomy, cytology, histology, paleozoology, and embryology, etc.

Androstenediol is a relatively weak endogenous androgen, and it is also an intermediate product of testosterone biosynthesis from dehydroepiandrosterone . Androstenediol and Androstenedione  have similar names, but note that the positions of their carbon-carbon double bonds are different.

Allura Red AC, also known as Temptation Red, is a red azo dye, also known as FD&C Red40 in the United States. It is used as a food coloring, with the E code E129. It is usually provided in the form of red sodium salt, but can also be used as calcium salt and potassium salt. These salts are soluble in water. In solution, its maximum absorbance is at about 504nm.
Entonox is a type of anesthetic gas, which is a mixture of 50% nitrous oxide and 50% oxygen. Entonox is often used in pre-hospital emergency care, childbirth, and emergency situations.

Nitrous oxide is a kind of combustion-supporting agent, initially used to help German aircraft quickly escape from the battlefield during World War II, and now used in modified cars for straight-line acceleration.
Cobblestone, basically a stone of cobble size, is a natural building material used for roads, streets, and buildings.

Red flower seeds, is one of the local snacks in Yichang, Hubei, Yichang dialect calls it "porcelain doll", like cold shrimp, often used as a summer drink. The method of making red flower seeds is to filter out the juice from a local seed called "red flower seeds" (the real name is "Xili") and add a small amount of water, stir well and add a small amount of lime to clarify, take the upper clear layer and freeze it overnight, when it becomes jelly-like, it is done. It can be mixed with brown sugar water for consumption. The red flower seeds seen on the street are mostly red because of the brown sugar water, and when the red flower seeds are made into a gel, they are colorless.

Mayonnaise (French: mayonnaise), also known as egg yolk sauce, is a thick semi-solid sauce made mainly from vegetable oil, eggs, lemon juice or vinegar, and other seasonings. It is generally divided into two methods: using only egg yolk and using whole eggs. Egg yolk sauce is a type of salad dressing, but not all salad dressings are egg yolk sauce. Egg yolk sauce is often used in salads, sandwiches and other dishes. The traditional shops in Chiayi, Taiwan, usually drizzle a salad dressing called white vinegar on the cold noodles they sell. Some people think that it is egg yolk sauce, but its taste is different from that of egg yolk sauce.

JavaOS  is an operating system, which is composed of Java Virtual Machine  and some basic software components, developed by Sun Microsystems. The Java Operating System, like the UNIX Operating System or UNIX-like Operating System, the main body of the UNIX Operating System and UNIX-like Operating System are developed and written in C language, while the main body of the Java Operating System is written in Java programming language.

Cucumber yogurt sauce, literally translated as Tzatziki, is a kind of sauce in Greek dietary culture. It is a kind of dip originated from the Ottoman Empire, using cucumber (pickles) and yogurt (whey yogurt) made from sheep's milk (sheep's milk or goat's milk). It is often seen in appetizers and is considered a healthy alternative to mayonnaise, which can be used to spread bread (including pita bread). Tzatziki is usually made from Greek yogurt and cucumber, garlic, salt, olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dill. American-style Tzatziki may also add lemon juice, mint, or coriander. Dishes similar to Tzatziki include buttermilk soup.

A pressure regulator is a device that automatically adjusts the outlet pressure of a fluid to stabilize it within a certain pressure range. It is usually a valve that operates on its own and maintains a constant controlled pressure, relying solely on the energy of the controlled fluid, so it is also known as a pressure regulating valve or a pressure reducing valve. In practical applications, pressure regulators are often used in gas pipelines. They are a special type of valve that can reduce the upstream gas pressure in the pipeline to a certain pressure and output it to the downstream valve. A gas pressure regulator is also a self-powered pressure regulating valve, which does not require an external power source.

The city-wide computer cleaning day is organized annually in collaboration with the Cyber Crime Prevention Group, the Government Information Technology Director's Office, and the Hong Kong Computer Security Incident Coordination Center, aiming to enhance the security awareness of information technology in Hong Kong society, encourage the public to "clean" computers, and provide practical network security advice to computer users.

relation.head: The city-wide computer cleaning day
relation.tail: Hong Kong Computer Security Incident Coordination Center

input: Mushrooms and bitter oranges from the agriculture, forestry and fishery industry are famous specialties of Oita Prefecture. The mushrooms have star-shaped marks on the top, so they are often ranked in the top few in the national dried mushroom selection in Japan. For the fishery part, high-grade fish such as yellowtail, bluefin tuna, and flounder are the main. The governor of Oita Prefecture, Hiratsu Morihiko, once advocated the activity of "one village, one product", so each town and village in the county has its own specialty. Recently, with the agglomeration of automobile-related industries in Miyawaka City and Kanda Town in Fukuoka Prefecture, the northern part of Oita Prefecture, which is close to this area, has gradually become an automobile industry agglomeration area. In 2004, Daihatsu Motor began to assemble and manufacture in Nakatsu City.

Tripe is a Chinese snack made from fresh bovine and ovine stomach, which is popular in northern regions such as Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei. The specific method is to cook the finely cut parts of the bovine and ovine stomach in boiling water, hot oil, or hot soup, and eat it with sesame sauce, black vinegar, scallions, chili oil, and other dips. Tripe is divided into two major categories according to the materials: bovine stomach and ovine stomach, and it is divided into water explosion, oil explosion, soup explosion, and others according to the production methods. Water explosion is the main method in Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei.

Corn dog is a kind of food made by wrapping a hot dog in a cornmeal batter and deep frying it, originated in the United States, and is usually served with ketchup. Originally, corn dogs were not skewered, but now they are almost always skewered for easy eating. The hot dogs used in corn dogs are usually mass-produced pink, with a very ordinary meaty texture, and the coating can usually increase the volume of the entire hot dog by nearly double. Due to its low cost and easy production, corn dogs are usually sold at night markets and tourist attractions.

The Harmony 3C type electric locomotive  is one of the electric locomotive models of China Railway, developed and manufactured by China North Vehicle Group Dalian Locomotive & Vehicle Co., Ltd. It is a high-power AC transmission mainline passenger and freight common electric locomotive developed and manufactured based on the HXD3 type electric locomotive design and manufacturing technology platform, and has borrowed the mature technology of the HXD3B type electric locomotive. Its continuous power is 7200kW, the maximum running speed is 120km/h, and it has a 600V DC train power supply system and a dual-tube air supply device.

relation.head: Harmony 3C type electric locomotive
relation.tail: China North Vehicle Group Dalian Locomotive & Vehicle Co., Ltd.

input: Zunhua Chestnut Liquor is a kind of white liquor produced in Zunhua, Hebei, originated from the liquor brewed by local people Gao Qingcheng in the late Kangxi years. Gao Zhenye, the son of Gao Qingcheng, inherited his father's business and tried to brew liquor with the locally abundant chestnuts, which took seven years to succeed. In 2004, Gao Yonghai, the seventh generation descendant of chestnut liquor, established a private enterprise and resumed the production of chestnut liquor according to the ancestral secret recipe, and four years later, he reformed and expanded production to this day. Zunhua Chestnut Liquor is made from chestnuts as the main ingredient, and is brewed through the traditional craft that has been selected as a city-level intangible cultural heritage.
The Cobra Armored Vehicle  is a wheeled light armored vehicle produced by Turkey's Otokar, functionally similar to the American HMMWV, and has been equipped in the Turkish Army since 1997.

China Great Wall Internet , with the Autonomous System number AS9389 , is exclusively for the People's Liberation Army of China, without international export bandwidth. According to relevant regulations and disciplines, content involving national and military secrets is prohibited from accessing from non-secret devices or external networks.

The Tūn Lóng heavy bomber, also known as the Type 100 heavy bomber, with the code Ki-49, was called "Helen" by the Allies. It was proposed by the Imperial Japanese Army in 1938 as a successor to the Mitsubishi Type 97 heavy bomber. This aircraft was developed and produced by Nakajima Aircraft, in addition to Tachikawa Aircraft Company and Manchukuo Aircraft Manufacturing. However, it was only slightly faster than the Type 97, with no significant improvements in top speed and bomb load. The only major improvement was the addition of a 20mm Ho-5 cannon for defensive firepower.

China Coast Guard 3210, formerly known as China Fisheries Law Enforcement 310, was designed by the 701 Institute Shanghai Branch and built by the Guangdong Zhanjiang Seaside Shipyard. It was launched on the morning of March 6, 2010, at the Guangdong Zhanjiang Seaside Shipyard, underwent sea trials in July, and officially entered service in November. It is the flagship of the China South Sea Fisheries Law Enforcement Fleet. It is also a Chinese law enforcement official ship of over 2000 tons equipped with armed organ guns.

A collider is a type of particle accelerator that can bring two particle beams together and allow the particles to collide with each other. At this time, the particles have been accelerated and have very high kinetic energy, which allows them to collide with other particles. Colliders are mainly used in particle physics.

The Whitehead Mark5 torpedo is a Whitehead torpedo adopted by the United States Navy in 1910 as an anti-surface warship torpedo. The Mk5 torpedo is the first torpedo produced by a foreign company, the British Whitehead factory, and manufactured by the United States Navy Torpedo Station located in Newport, Rhode Island in 1908. It is also the first torpedo that allows the launching ship to adjust its range and speed.

Wheat is rich in starch, protein, fat, minerals, calcium, iron, thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, etc. Due to different varieties and environmental conditions, the nutritional components vary greatly. From the perspective of protein content, the wheat grains grown in continental arid climate zones are hard and transparent, with a higher protein content, reaching 14 to 20%, and the gluten is strong and elastic, suitable for baking bread; the wheat grains grown in humid conditions contain 8 to 10% protein, the grains are soft, the gluten is poor, which shows that the geographical climate has a very important impact on the formation process of the product.

Miniature submarines, also known as pocket submarines, are a type of submarine that are small in size, carry few crew members, and have a displacement of less than 100 tons. Miniature submarines are mainly used in military, security, research, and exploration. Although miniature submarines have weak firepower, they can support special operations and assist other submarines or ships in resupplying, such as the submarines used by special forces on the American Virginia-class submarines.

Gujeolpan is an appetizer in ancient Korean court cuisine, which can also refer to the container for this dish. It is a traditional Korean dish where 9 kinds of food are placed in a octagonal box with 9 compartments. In the middle of Gujeolpan, a thin pancake is usually placed, and the surrounding 8 compartments are filled with egg white strips, egg yolk strips, carrot strips, stir-fried beef strips, stone ear strips, cucumber strips, bean sprouts, mushroom strips, etc., according to the five flavors and five colors. The taste is mainly light, and the ingredients are freely matched and placed on the thin pancake roll, served with soy sauce, mustard or chili sauce. In modern Korean society, Gujeolpan has become a dish for Korean New Year or wedding banquets, but it is often simplified to a thin pancake with 6 kinds of ingredients, called Chiljeolpan.

relation.head: Chiljeolpan
relation.tail: thin pancake with 6 kinds of ingredients

input: The bladeless fan, also known as the fanless fan, is a type of electric fan, but it is not truly fanless, as the blades are actually hidden in the base. The design patent was first obtained by Tokyo Shibaura Company in Japan in 1981, but it was not put into production. A nearly identical design of the bladeless fan was manufactured and put on the market by James Dyson of the UK in 2009. James Dyson applied for the patent for this design but was rejected on the grounds that compared to the design of Toshiba in Japan, James Dyson's design could not be considered innovative or a new design.

The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive, also known as DF11G, is a double-engine heavy-duty quasi-high-speed internal combustion locomotive model used by China Railway. It was specially developed by CRRC Qishuyan Locomotive Co., Ltd. for the fifth major speed increase of China Railway. Its design draws on the technology of the DF11 and DF11Z locomotives, and can meet the application conditions of single-driver shift operation and long-distance continuous operation, and has the function of supplying power to passenger cars. It is also the first internal combustion locomotive in China to adopt full microcomputer control technology.

relation.head: The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive
The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive

input: A bread machine  is a machine for making bread. After the user puts the bread-making ingredients into the bread machine, the bread machine will automatically complete the kneading, fermentation and baking, the three main procedures for making bread. After the user opens the lid of the bread machine, they can take out the freshly baked bread. Most bread machines are built-in with microcomputers, allowing the bread-making process to be automated, so it is also called an "automatic bread maker". Although this automatic bread-making machine has had different Chinese names in the past, it is now most commonly known as "bread machine" in mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong and Macau regions.

relation.head: bread machine
relation.tail: mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong and Macau regions

input: The Australian aboriginal bread has a history of thousands of years in Australia. This tradition gradually disappeared when the pre-ground white flour from Europe arrived in Australia. Bread making is a traditional women's job. It involves collecting seasonal grass or dried fruits. These are the materials they prepare for making flour. Because it is labor-intensive work, several ladies are required to participate each time.

Granola, also often referred to as oats or fruit oats, is a food made from oatmeal, nuts, and honey through baking. Granola is often used as breakfast or snacks. Although it originated in the United States, it is also popular in places like Japan. In addition, besides the loose packaging method, granola is often made into bars for convenience.

A thermal airship is a type of airship that generates lift by heating the gas inside to reduce its density. Most of the existing thermal airships are filled with air, just like hot air balloons. Some thermal airships are designed to use gases lighter than air and heat a part of it  to increase additional lift. The first well-known thermal airship was the Cameron D-96, made by Don Cameron, a British man, and was unveiled in 1973. It took 3 years to develop.

Yu'ebao is a fund management service launched by Alipay, which belongs to Ant Financial Group. Transferring money into Yu'ebao means buying a money market fund supported by MYbank and Tianhong Fund, and users can use the funds for consumption expenditure at any time.

Cheese is a major agricultural product worldwide. According to the data from the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization, the world produced over 20 million tons of cheese in 2011, equivalent to about three kilograms per person. The largest cheese-producing country in the world is the United States, accounting for about 26% of the world's production, followed by Germany and France. The cheese produced in the United States is mainly mozzarella and cheddar, far more than other types of cheese.

The jazz drum, usually referred to as the drum set, is a type of percussion art that appeared in the 1910s Dixieland jazz, 1970s jazz rock, 1980s Latin jazz and other modern jazz. The playing style of jazz drums is constantly updated under the influence of its origin in New Orleans and other regions in the United States, the Caribbean, and Africa. In addition, because jazz requires a more flexible and changeable form of percussion instruments different from traditional European music to adapt to the rhythm requirements of various new styles, the performance skills of jazz drums have also become more complex and changeable.

Polar fleece, also known as fleece, double-sided brushed cloth, or shaking velvet, is a soft, synthetic fiber fabric with a fluffy surface, made from Polyethylene terephthalate . The first polar fleece was invented by Malden Mills in 1979. Polar fleece has some of the advantages of wool, but is much lighter than wool.

The USS Wright , also known as the Wright aircraft carrier, is the second ship of the two Saipan-class aircraft carriers of the United States Navy. It was built during World War II, converted from a cruiser hull, and later converted into a command ship CC-2 due to the excessive number of larger tonnage aircraft carriers in the US Navy. The "Wright" is the second US warship with this name, the previous one was a supply ship , named after Orville Wright, the younger brother of the Wright brothers who invented the airplane, while this aircraft carrier was named after both brothers, Orville and Wilbur.

Pourquoi Pas ?IV  is the fourth ship built for the French explorer Jean-Baptiste Charcot. It was completed during Charcot's second Antarctic expedition from 1908 to 1910. On September 16, 1936, Pourquoi Pas and Charcot were buried at sea off Iceland, with only one of the 40 crew members rescued.

The most common sports bras today are similar to a vest that has been cut in half, made from fibers with high stretchability and good sweat absorption , and there are also products designed with colloids, water pads, and airbags. After some surgeries, some women also choose to wear sports bras to fix their breasts for wound healing. The straps of ordinary bras cause some women to feel tense when doing arm-lifting exercises, because the fixed bra is stretched, directly pressing on the trapezius muscle, which may eventually lead to symptoms such as shoulder numbness or pain. Sports bras are tied at the back so they can avoid this problem.

Andong Soju is produced in Andong, its history can be traced back to the period of the Mongol invasion of the Goryeo Dynasty. It is brewed using traditional rice distillation techniques, with an alcohol content of 45 degrees, and was designated as an intangible cultural heritage of Gyeongsangbuk-do, South Korea in 1987.

Salyut 6, code-named DOS-5, a Soviet near-Earth orbit space station, was part of the Salyut program, launched on September 29, 1977. It was originally designed to last for 1.5 years, but in fact, it operated in orbit for 4 years and 10 months. It belongs to the second generation of space stations.

The USS Missouri BB-63 is a battleship belonging to the United States Navy, the third ship of the Iowa-class battleships. She is the third US military ship named after the state of Missouri, and also the last battleship built by the US Navy. She is the last battleship retired by the US in World War II, and is also famous for being designated as the surrender ship at the end of World War II.

Chaozhou wood carving, also known as Chaozhou gold lacquer wood carving, is a folk carving art popular in Chaozhou City, Shantou City, Jieyang City and other places in the former Chaozhou Prefecture of Guangdong Province. It is especially known for its multi-layered hollowing and golden lacquer wood carving. It is known as one of the four major wood carvings in China, along with Dongyang wood carving, boxwood carving, and longan wood carving. Chaozhou wood carving has a long history, developed during the Tang and Song dynasties, matured in the late Ming dynasty, and reached its peak in the middle and late Qing dynasty. On May 20, 2006, it was listed in the first batch of China's national intangible cultural heritage list.
Mazda CX-9 is a large crossover SUV launched by the Japanese Mazda Motor Corporation in 2007, which can accommodate seven people and is exclusively sold in North America and some parts of Asia.

The Tūn Lóng heavy bomber was first deployed to the Chinese battlefield. After the outbreak of the Pacific War, it first took off from New Guinea on February 19, 1942, to bomb Darwin Port in Australia. However, Tūn Lóng was still difficult to defend against the attack of the Allied fighters. For example, a large number of Tūn Lóng were shot down by American fighters in the Battle of Leyte Gulf. Tūn Lóng also served as a kamikaze plane to hit American ships or added radar and magnetic anomaly detectors to serve as maritime patrol aircraft. After World War II, Tūn Lóng heavy bombers were still used by Indonesians to fight against the Dutch army, and the French army also used 3 Tūn Lóng to deal with the Viet Minh led by Ho Chi Minh.
Pancake balls, also known as apple slices, are a Danish snack.

The Audi A8 is a standard luxury car produced by the German Audi. It is also the top model in the Audi brand. Its main competitors are the BMW 7 Series, Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Lexus LS, Toyota Crown, Honda Mileage, Nissan Fuga, Jaguar XJ, etc. It is the first car in the same class to use a lightweight all-aluminum alloy body, and there are multiple engines that can be matched with four-wheel drive for car owners who value handling or live in snowy areas. In 1996, an upgraded version of the A8, the Audi S8, was also produced.

The San Telmo , also known as the Saint Peter Gonzalez or the Saint Erasmus of Friesland, is a Spanish 74-gun sailing battleship launched in 1788. In 1819, the flagship San Telmo, led by Rosen Polirel, went to Peru's Cayao to suppress the Spanish American revolutionary movement, but was severely damaged by bad weather in the Drake Strait of Cape Horn and sank in September 1819. The 644 crew members on board were the first people to die in the Antarctic waters, and the shipwreck remains were found on Livingston Island.

Tom Yum , is a famous Thai hot and sour soup, made from galangal, tamarind, lemongrass, green onion, sour lemon, chili and fish sauce. The most common cooking method is to add shrimp and straw mushrooms, season with fish sauce and form a milky texture of Tom Yum Kung. There are also hot and sour chicken soup, hot and sour seafood soup, hot and sour coconut milk soup, etc.

Chicken McNuggets is a dish launched by the international fast food chain McDonald's in 1983 in its international franchise restaurants. It is a chicken product made by processing and stirring chicken into meat paste, then adding bread crumbs and frying it. Roughly speaking, 6 Chicken McNuggets have about 250 kilocalories. To this day, Chicken McNuggets are still one of the popular products in McDonald's food. Nugget means gold nugget, named after the Chicken McNuggets' shape similar to gold nuggets.

The FD type steam locomotive is a mainline freight steam locomotive of the Soviet Railways, named after the two Russian initials ФД of the early Soviet leader Trotsky. This locomotive was produced by the Voroshilovgrad Steam Locomotive Factory and the Ulan-Ude Steam Locomotive Factory from 1931 to 1942, with a total of 3213 units, and the maximum speed is 85 kilometers per hour.

Soyuz TMA-02M is one of the Russian Soyuz TMA series spacecraft, and the second improved Soyuz TMA-M series spacecraft. The spacecraft, carrying three astronauts, was successfully launched at 21:12 UTC on June 7, 2011, from the Baikonur launch site in Kazakhstan, heading for the International Space Station.

The A320 family of aircraft adopts a universal design, with a slightly smaller , even smaller , or larger , and their operation methods are the same. The passenger capacity ranges from 100 to 220 people. The main competitors are Boeing 737, 757-200 and 717. Technically speaking, "A320" refers specifically to the original medium-sized passenger aircraft, but it often also represents the entire 320 family: A318/A319/A320/A321. All models have the Extended Twin Operations Standard  rating.

The Brazilian Pike Cichlid is one of the species of the Cichlidae family in the suborder of Cichlasomatinae, order of Perciformes, and class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the freshwater areas of Ceará, Paraíba, Rio Grande do Norte, and Pernambuco in Brazil, South America. It can reach a length of 7.8 cm and inhabits the middle layer of river bottoms. Its habits are unknown.

The Suriname Spear Cichlid is one of the species of the Cichlidae family in the suborder of Cichlasomatinae, order of Perciformes, and class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Coppename River and the Saramacca River basin in Suriname, South America. It can reach a length of 17.9 cm and inhabits the middle layer of the river bottom. Its habits are unknown.

relation.head: Suriname Spear Cichlid
relation.tail: Coppename River and the Saramacca River basin in Suriname, South America

input: The Green-buttocked Hidden Beautiful Fish, a species of the Pomacentridae family in the suborder of the Perciformes order of the Actinopterygii class, is distributed in the Guarumo River basin in Central America, Panama. It can reach a length of 6.4 cm and inhabits the middle and bottom waters, but its habits are unknown.

The killer whale is at the top of the food chain, so it has no natural enemies. The only enemy of the killer whale is humans. Although it has not been targeted by the whaling industry in history, every year there are still several to hundreds of killer whales killed by fishermen. In addition, the industrial wastewater discharged into the sea causes marine pollution, affecting the habitat of killer whales. The sound of the ship's propeller affects the sonar system of the killer whale and scares away the fish. In addition, the overfishing of large marine fish in recent years, especially the sharp decrease in the number of salmon and tuna, which are the main food of the fish-eating killer whales, makes them starve and unable to breed the next generation, affecting the diversity of the killer whale population.

Bashu people, commonly known as Sichuan people, are sometimes also called Chuan people or Chuan-Yu people, and very few are called Bashu people. It refers to the local people in Sichuan and Chongqing areas now or in the past, most of whom now use Sichuan dialect as their first or second mother tongue, have a unique sense of identity , and identify with Bashu culture. input: Koscina Company  is a civilian optical instrument manufacturing company. Its headquarters is located at 1081 Yoshida, Nakano City, Nagano Prefecture. It was originally called Niko, and was renamed Cosina in 1973.

The official name of the school's sports team is the Buffalo Bulls. The American football team has cultivated several professional rugby players in the 1950s. Starting from 1996, the school's sports team joined the Mid-American Conference and began to participate in the NCAA league. In the most important men's basketball and rugby events, the school team has always performed poorly. In 2005, the basketball team stopped just outside the NCAA finals with a slight gap, creating the best performance in recent years. In the same year, in order to change the poor performance of the rugby team, the school hired an experienced new coach.

Pangda Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. , ranked 181st in the "2009 China Top 500 Enterprises". By the end of 2012, its market value reached 13.5 billion. The current legal representative of the company is Pang Qinghua. The company's main business is car dealership and maintenance services.

The Central Bank of Kenya, also known as CBK, was established in 1966 and is the central bank of Kenya, headquartered in the capital Nairobi. The current governor is Njuguna Ndung'u, who took office on March 4, 2007.

The International Bodybuilding Association was founded by the brothers Joe Wade and Ben Wade in 1946. A resolution to change the English name to a longer one was made at a meeting in November 2004, but the abbreviation on the logo remained unchanged.

Until the 2010s, many places in Guangzhou proposed plans to build a tram network. On January 30, 2013, Guangzhou Tram Co., Ltd. was established, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Guangzhou Underground Railway Company .

The Chinese Physical Society has 7 working committees, 28 branches and professional committees, and governs 31 local physical societies. The working committees include the Science Popularization Working Committee, the Publishing Working Committee, the Consulting Working Committee, the Physics Terminology Committee, the Physics Teaching Committee, the Academic Exchange Committee, and the Women Physics Workers Committee.

Hefei No.11 Middle School  is a municipal complete middle school founded in 1958 in Hefei City, Anhui Province, People's Republic of China. It is also a demonstrative general high school in Anhui Province and a green school in Anhui Province. Hefei Eleven Middle School has a total of 54 classes, with about 3000 students, 140 faculty and staff, including 62 senior teachers, 68 intermediate teachers, 4 special language teachers, 3 special math teachers, and 4 special geography teachers.

China University of Mining and Technology, abbreviated as CUMT, is a university directly under the Ministry of Education, mainly focusing on engineering and characterized by mining. It is one of the first universities to enter China's "211 Project" and "Advantageous Subject Innovation Platform Project". It is also one of the first universities to build world-class disciplines. Its predecessor was Jiaozuo Lu Mine School, which was founded in Jiaozuo, Henan in 1909. It is currently located in Xuzhou City, Jiangsu Province.

input: Sichuan Conservatory of Music is composed of two campuses, new and old. The old campus is located in the center of Chengdu, bordered by the Jinjiang River to the north and Sichuan University to the south, covering an area of 116 acres. The new campus is located in Xindu District of Chengdu, 16 kilometers away from the center, covering an area of 1040 acres. The conservatory has 10,000 students, 1240 faculty and staff, and 810 full-time teachers. The conservatory has teaching units such as Mianyang Art College of Sichuan Conservatory of Music, Popular Music College of Sichuan Conservatory of Music, Chengdu Art College of Sichuan Conservatory of Music, International Performing Arts College of Sichuan Conservatory of Music, and the affiliated middle school of Sichuan Conservatory of Music.

input: Ningno recruits undergraduate students, master's students, and doctoral students from home and abroad, with more than 8000 registered students from over 70 countries and regions around the world. So far, Ningno has trained 13 batches of undergraduate graduates and 14 batches of master's graduates, and has been enrolling doctoral students since 2009. The undergraduate admissions of Ningbo Nottingham University are included in the general higher education admissions plan in mainland China, and the college entrance examination scores are used as the basis for admissions for mainland Chinese students, while the admission qualifications for international students are the same as the Nottingham University system. The master's and doctoral stages are carried out independently with standards not lower than those of the UK campus.

FK Liepājas Metalurgs was a football club based in Liepāja, Latvia, but it was disbanded in 2013. The team's home stadium was Daugava Stadium, which can accommodate 5,100 people. In 2005, Metalurgs became the first team to break the 14-year monopoly of the Latvian Football Super League championship held by Skonto since the league was re-established in 1991.

Dezhou College, established in May 1971, is a comprehensive undergraduate institution located in Dezhou City, Shandong Province. Its predecessor was Dezhou Normal Specialized School. The main campus address is No. 566, University West Road, Decheng District, Dezhou City, Shandong Province. In 2021, there are about 25,000 full-time students and 17,000 adult education students. The school covers an area of about 2021 acres, with a building area of about 689,000 square meters.

Fairchild Semiconductor, commonly known as "Fairy Child Semiconductor", is a semiconductor design and manufacturing company in the United States, currently headquartered in Sunnyvale. It once developed the world's first commercial integrated circuit . The founders of important companies in the current semiconductor industry, such as Intel and AMD, all come from this company. Fairchild Semiconductor occupies an important position in the history of Silicon Valley.
Viz, derived from "visual", is a brand under the Japanese publishing house Shogakukan, with companies in Japan and overseas, especially known for "VIZ Media" in the United States.
Porthcawl, an administrative division of Wales, UK, is located 40 kilometers west of Cardiff City, 30.5 kilometers southeast of Swansea, on the coast of South Wales, overlooking Bristol Bay.

The Nan Zhongliao area, with Xiangqinliao as the main center, borders the North Zhongliao area of Zhongliao Township to the north, the Nantou area of Nantou City to the west, Jiji Town to the south, and Guoxing Township and Shuili Township to the east.

Weiyuan County is a county in the western part of Chongjin Province, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, with the Gangnam Mountain Range running through the middle, and the Yalu River to the northwest, overlooking Jilin Province, China. There are also the Tulu River, Weiyuan River, etc. The highest point is Mount Suiji, which is 1,994 meters above sea level. The area is 1,160.4 square kilometers, and the population was 60,245 in 2008. It is divided into 1 town, 2 labor districts, and 20 villages. The county was established in 1443, abolished in 1460, and restored in 1463. In 1949, it was transferred from Ping'an North Road to Chongjin Province.

The Division of Corio is a lower house district in Victoria, Australia, centered on Geelong. It is named after Corio Bay. The area is 815 square kilometers. The district began in 1900 and is one of the original seventy-five congressional districts. This district was a competitive district for the Labor Party and right-wing parties before 1967, and has since been a safe district for the Labor Party. The current district representative is Richard Marles.

Tangwo, a Chinese village in the mountainous border area of northern Thailand, is administratively located in Nanpu, Chabaogan County, Chiang Mai. In the 1960s, Tangwo became the last station of the Third Army of the original Yunnan Anti-Communist National Salvation Army, which later became the Northern Thailand Volunteer Self-Defense Force. The troops and families of the Third Army settled here. Local facilities such as military barracks, schools, memorial halls, and martyrs' shrines have been preserved.
