input: The Soan culture is distributed in the Indus Valley and its tributary, the Soan River, with its center located in Rawalpindi .

Yelang County, a county of the Jin and Tang dynasties. In the fifth year of Yongjia of the Western Jin Dynasty , Yelang County was established by dividing Zhuti County, Jianning County, and Zangke County. The county seat was in Yelang County (now Guanling Buyi and Miao Autonomous County, Guizhou Province). It includes the area upstream of the North Panjiang River in Yunnan and Guizhou, west of the Liuzhi Special Zone in Guizhou Province. Yelang County was abolished during the reign of Dabao in the Southern Liang Dynasty. During the Tianbao and Zhide years of the Tang Dynasty, Zhenzhou was once changed to Yelang County. The county seat was in Yelang County (now northwest of Zheng'an County, Guizhou Province). It includes Zheng'an County, Guizhou Province, and Daozhen Gelao and Miao Autonomous County. The prefect of Yelang County.

Westville, is a city under Holmes County, Florida, United States. It was established in 1970. The area is about 19.3 square kilometers . According to the 2010 U.S. Census, the city has a population of 289. It ranks 387th in terms of population in the state.

The coasts of northern Chile in the east and west of South America and southeastern Brazil are both large fishing grounds produced by the convergence of cold and warm ocean currents, producing a large number of fish such as sardines and tuna.

Pulau Aman, also known as "Aman Island", is a small island in the northwest of Seberang Perai, Penang, Malaysia, often hailed as the "Island of Peace", and was once known as Monkey Island. Tourist attractions include Jinjing Street, Robber Street, and the nearby Gedong Island. There is a fishing village on Aman Island where you can stay overnight, and fishing enthusiasts can also fish here.
Ueno Province, one of the ancient administrative divisions of Japan, belonged to Tōsandō, also known as Jōshū. The territory of Ueno Province is approximately the current Gunma Prefecture.

Mainz is a city in Rhineland-Palatinate that does not belong to any county. The mayor is directly elected by the citizens, and Michael Ebling of the Social Democratic Party of Germany  has been serving as the mayor since 2012.

Ambohimanga is a World Heritage Site located about 24 kilometers east of the capital of Madagascar, Antananarivo. This walled town includes residences for key members of the royal family, cemeteries, and sacrificial buildings. The ruins are one of the pilgrimage sites for religious believers in Madagascar and a wider area. A series of building groups were listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2001, with a registered area of 59ha and a buffer zone area of 425ha.
Sibi District, a district of Balochistan Province in Pakistan. The total area is 4,152 square kilometers, and the total population is 250,000 . The county seat is located in Sibi.

Karimnagar County, under the jurisdiction of Telangana State, India, is bordered by Nizamabad County to the west, Adilabad County to the north, and Warangal County and Medak County to the south. The total area is 11,823 square kilometers, with a total population of 3,491,822 in 2001. The population in 2011 was 3,811,738. The county seat is located in Karimnagar. Before the establishment of Telangana State in 2014, this county belonged to Andhra Pradesh.

Xiaqi Village is a village under the jurisdiction of Jiangwan Town, Wuyuan County, Shangrao City, Jiangxi Province, China. In 2003, Xiaqi Village was listed as the first batch of historical and cultural villages in Jiangxi Province. The ancient architectural complex of Xiaqi, is a cultural relic protection unit of Shangrao City, including the following ancient buildings:

Licheng County, an ancient county name in China. It was established in the Western Han Dynasty, and its administrative center was located in the current Qianlicheng Village, Jiaolong Town, Linshu County, Shandong Province. It belonged to the Donghai County. During the reign of Emperor Wu of Han, Liu Ding, the son of Liu Xi , was made the Marquis of Licheng. During the reign of Wang Mang, it was renamed "Liuquan", and the old name was restored in the Eastern Han Dynasty. At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, it was the administrative center of Licheng County. During the period of the Five Hu chaos, the county people moved south, and the northern territory of Haiyu County in Wu County  was relocated to Licheng County, which was called Nanlicheng. During the Liu Song Dynasty, Licheng County was abolished. In the fourth year of Wude in the Tang Dynasty , Licheng County was re-established, and in the eighth year , it was merged into Huairen County.

relation.head: Qianlicheng Village, Jiaolong Town, Linshu County

input: Orlovsky, formerly known as Spokoynoye, is a town-level city in the Agaburiat District of the Trans-Baikal Territory of Russia, belonging to the Akinskoye District, located in the eastern part of the district, southeast of the district administrative center Akinskoye and southeast of the capital of the border region, Chita. The population of this place was 1,894 in 2021; 2,194 in 2010; 2,348 in 2002; and 3,366 in 1989.

Diamer County is a county in the southwest of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. It is bordered by Gilgit County and Ghizer County to the north, and Astor County to the east. The county seat is located in Chilas. The Karakoram Highway passes through this place.

The site of Chengzi Village, located in Chengzi Village, Sandao Township, Yitong County, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is an ancient city site, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Yitong County Cultural Management Office. The historical era of the Chengzi Village site is the Jin Dynasty.

Bannu District, a district in the southern part of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. The total area is 12,270 square kilometers, and the total population is 677,346. The county seat is located in Bannu.

The former residence of Gao Zhihang is located at No. 40 Longquan Road, Dongchang District, Tonghua City, Jilin Province, China. It is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit, classified as an important modern historical site and representative building, and was announced on May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Tonghua City Cultural Relics Management Committee Office. The historical era of Gao Zhihang's former residence is modern. On August 14, 2002, on the 65th anniversary of the August 14th Air Battle victory, the "Gao Zhihang Martyrs Memorial Hall"  was opened under the auspices of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Air Force, Tonghua City People's Government, Beijing Aviation Association and other units.

Mansehra County is a county in the northeast of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. The total area is 4,579 square kilometers, and the total population is 1,152,839 . The Karakoram Highway passes through this county.

Fuyu Prefecture, a prefecture set up by the Bohai State, was named after the old land of Fuyu State. Bohai established Fuyu Prefecture, which governed Fuzhou and Xianzhou, and was under the jurisdiction of Yongping, Fuyu, Buduo, Xianyi, Quechuan, Qiangshi , Xin'an, and Yugu. The jurisdiction is approximately today's Nong'an County, Changchun City, Liaoyuan City, Siping City in Jilin Province, and Kaiyuan City, Xifeng County, Changtu County in Liaoning Province. In the first month of the first year of Tianxian , Emperor Taizu of Liao pacified Bohai and took Fuyu Prefecture. In March, he took the Dragon Spring Prefecture, the capital of the Bohai State, and moved Longzhou to Fuyu Prefecture, and both Fuzhou and Xianzhou were abolished. In September, Emperor Taizong of Liao changed the name of Fuyu Prefecture to Huanglong Prefecture because a yellow dragon appeared when Emperor Taizu died in Fuyu City.

Stockton North (English: Stockton North), a parliamentary constituency in the UK, includes the northern part of Stockton-on-Tees in the northeast of England. It was established in 1983. This area has always supported the Labour Party's candidates. In the 2010 general election, the incumbent councillor Frank Cook sought re-election as an independent candidate, but was defeated by Alexander Cunningham, recommended by the Labour Party, with 42.8% of the votes. Cook only got 4.0% of the votes, ranking fifth among seven people.

Bamiyan, formerly known as "Fanyanna, Fanyang Country, Wangyan Country, Fanyan Country", is located in the central part of Afghanistan and is the capital of Bamiyan Province. The famous Bamiyan Buddha is located near this city.

Izalco Volcano is a volcano in the western part of El Salvador, located at the southern foot of Santa Ana Volcano. It is a parasitic complex volcano of Santa Ana Volcano. It has been erupting almost continuously from 1770 to 1958, and a volcanic eruption occurred in 1966. The eruption in 1926 buried a nearby village, causing 56 deaths.

Jiaozhi County, also known as Jiaozhi County, is an ancient Chinese name for Vietnam, which was the county name from the Western Han Dynasty to the Tang Dynasty in China, equivalent to the Red River Delta in northern Vietnam. Later, Jiaozhi became independent from China, but China and Japan still referred to the various regimes in the area as "Jiaozhi". The emperor of the Song Dynasty also conferred the title of "King of Jiaozhi County" on the emperor of the Ding Dynasty who ruled the Red River Delta in Vietnam. The Yuan Dynasty and the Ming Dynasty also briefly established the Jiaozhi Province and the Jiaozhi Chengxuanbuzhengshi Division respectively.

relation.head: Red River Delta in northern Vietnam

input: Bay Harbor Islands (English: Bay Harbor Islands) is a town under Miami-Dade County, Florida, USA. It was established in 1947. The area is about 1.6 square kilometers (about 0.6 square miles). According to the 2010 US Census, the city has a population of 5,628. It ranks 205th in terms of population in the state.

Yanlong Subdistrict is a subdistrict office under the jurisdiction of Yandu District, Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. It was established in 2010. The administrative area of Yanlong Subdistrict is 48.23 square kilometers, with a population of 46,587.

Dumfries and Galloway, a constituency of the British Parliament, is located in the southwest of Scotland, including part of Dumfries-Galloway. It was established in 2005. In 2005, it belonged to the Dumfries constituency, and Russell Brown of the Labour Party was elected and successfully re-elected in the 2010 general election with 45.9%.

Lake Guiers , also known as Lake Gaier, is a freshwater lake in the northwest of Senegal, located 64 kilometers east of Saint Louis. The lake water mainly relies on the Ferlo River in the south for replenishment, and the lake water flows into the Senegal River in the north. In 1916, a dam was built to prevent the salt water from the Senegal River Delta from flowing into the lake, providing salt-alkali land for pastoralists. The lake water is used for irrigation and drinking, and is an important source of drinking water for Dakar.

Shenhou Town is a town under the jurisdiction of Yuzhou City, Henan Province, China. It is located in the central part of Henan Province, 30 kilometers southwest of Yuzhou City, on the southeastern edge of Jishan, a branch of Funiu Mountain. China's Jun porcelain originated from here and is known as the "Capital of China's Jun Porcelain". On November 12, 2005, it was jointly named by the Ministry of Construction and the State Administration of Cultural Heritage as the second batch of China's historical and cultural towns. In October 2016, it was selected as the first batch of "China's Characteristic Towns" by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development. It is also a key town for national small town construction and the Capital of China's Jun Porcelain. In 2019, it was rated as one of the top 100 cultural towns in China.

Songshan County, an ancient county name in China. During the Liao Dynasty, it was a county under Songshan Prefecture. The Songshan Prefecture was abolished during the Jin Dynasty. In the third year of Zhongtong in the Yuan Dynasty , it was promoted to Songzhou, and Songshan County remained. In the second year of Zhiyuan , Songshan County was incorporated into Songzhou. The administrative center is now in the northwest of the ancient Daning City in Pingquan County, Hebei Province.

relation.tail: northwest of the ancient Daning City

input: Baoshan Town is a township-level administrative unit under Fengcheng City, Dandong City, Liaoning Province, People's Republic of China.

Carcross (English: Carcross), an unincorporated community in the Yukon region of Canada, is 74 kilometers away from the Alaska Highway. The total population of the area is 431 (as of June 2008). North of Carcross town is the Carcross Desert, known as the "smallest desert in the world".

According to Article 3 of the German "Wine Law", Rheingau (German: Rheingau) is one of the thirteen high-quality dining wine production areas in Germany. The wine-producing area of Rheingau refers to a narrow strip located on the west side of Wiesbaden, between the Rhine and the Taunus Mountains. Within this strip, the Rhine flows westward and the Taunus Mountains are located to the north. The vineyards near Flörsheim in Wiesbaden, which extend to the mouth of the Rhine, also belong to this production area. This production area has a total of about 3100 hectares of vineyards, most of which are Riesling varieties.

Simberi Island is a volcanic island in Papua New Guinea, located 25 kilometers northeast of New Ireland Island in the Pacific Ocean. It is part of the Tabar Islands and is administered by the New Ireland Province. The island is 9.5 kilometers long, 7.7 kilometers wide, with an area of 40 square kilometers, and the highest point is 340 meters above sea level. The population is about 1100 people, mainly living in the villages in the northwest of the island. The local residents mainly use the Simberi dialect of the Tabar language.

Menglou Town is a town under the jurisdiction of Dengzhou City, Henan Province, China, located in the southwest of Dengzhou City, 30 kilometers away from the city area. It is connected to Menglou Town in Laohekou City, Hubei Province, and is bordered by the Central Plains to the north and the land of fish and rice in Jingchu to the south. It is known as the "gateway to Shaanxi and Jianghan, where merchants gather and goods pile up like mountains". It has been selected as the "National Small Town Construction Pilot Town", "Henan Province Reform and Development Construction Comprehensive Pilot Town", "Nanyang City Reform and Opening Up Special Experimental Zone", "Henan Province Financial System Reform Pilot Town", "Nanyang City Financial Construction Pilot Town" and "Henan Province Key Town".

Hitachi Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to the Tokaido region, also known as Changzhou. The territory of Hitachi Province is roughly equivalent to most of the current Ibaraki Prefecture , and it contains Kasumigaura, the second largest lake in Japan.

Yuanbaoshan National Forest Park is located in Rongshui Miao Autonomous County, Liuzhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China. It is a scenic spot in Liuzhou, with mountain villages of Miao, Yao, and Dong ethnic groups. The most unique scenery is the rock stepping waterfall, which is more than 300 meters high and more than 10 meters wide, and there are precious plants such as thousand-year-old fir and five-needle pine. The highest peak in the park is Yuanbaoshan, which is 2081 meters high.

Liyang County, a county from the Jin Dynasty to the Tang Dynasty. Liyang County was established in the first year of Yongxing of Emperor Hui of Jin , and its administrative center was in Liyang County . It includes today's He County and Hanshan County in Anhui Province. During the Northern Qi Dynasty, Hezhou was established within its jurisdiction. In the ninth year of Kaihuang of Emperor Wen of Sui , Sui destroyed the Southern Chen Dynasty and abolished Liyang County. In the early years of Daye, Liyang County was re-established, governing Liyang and Wujiang, with a population of 8,254. During the Tianbao and Zhide years of the Tang Dynasty, Hezhou was once changed to Liyang County. It governs Liyang County, Wujiang County, and Hanshan County. The governor of Liyang County in the Tang Dynasty.

Gujarat state in India currently has jurisdiction over 33 counties. When Gujarat state was split from Bombay state in 1960, it had jurisdiction over 17 counties in the northern part of the original Bombay state. Gandhinagar county was newly established in 1964. Valsad county was newly established in 1966. In 1997, 5 new counties were established by splitting from the original counties. Patan county was newly established in 2000. In some maps of Middle-earth, the Swanfleet is another name for a river, but in reality, this name only refers to this swamp. Glithui is a tributary of the Teiglin River. Greyflood, see Gwathló. Greylin is a headwater stream of the Anduin River. Gwathló, also known as Greyflood, is a river in the middle of Eriador.

The source of the Red River is located at the junction of Dali City in Dali Prefecture, Yunnan Province, and Weishan County, on the main ridge of the northernmost end of the Ailao Mountain Range, a place called "Egou Abao" in the local Yi language, meaning "the father of a winding water".

The Frontier Region Bannu  is a frontier region of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Pakistan. This frontier region is named after the adjacent Bannu County. It borders the North Waziristan Special Area to the west, Karak County and Lakki Marwat Frontier Region to the north, and Bannu County to the east.

Shoemaker crater  is a severely eroded impact crater located about 100 kilometers north-northeast of Wiluna in Western Australia, on a dry wasteland. This meteorite crater was renamed to commemorate the planetary scientist Eugene Shoemaker.

The Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Marseille is a metropolitan archdiocese in France, with seven dioceses under its jurisdiction. Traditionally, the diocese is believed to have been established in the 1st century and was elevated to a directly controlled archdiocese of the Holy See on January 31, 1948. It was elevated to a metropolitan archdiocese on December 8, 2002. The archdiocese is located in the Marseille district of the Rhone estuary province, with 700,000 parishioners  in 2004, 122 parishes, and 313 priests. The current archbishop is Jean-Marc Aveline, and the emeritus archbishop is Georges Pontier.

relation.head: The Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Marseille

input: In 1816, Mainz was assigned to the Grand Duchy of Hesse-Darmstadt, and its political and economic status declined significantly, gradually becoming an unimportant provincial city. The fortresses around the city hindered its development. During this period, almost no significant events occurred in the city. The Mainz Carnival was formed here in 1837. It was not until 1886 that the city was expanded and the population increased dramatically. Compared with other surrounding cities, such as Wiesbaden, the overall development of Mainz was not ideal due to its fortress function.

Lagoa  is a wealthy residential area in the South Zone of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, around the Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon, adjacent to Ipanema, Leblon, Copacabana, Gávea, Botanical Garden, and Humaitá. Lagoa is the third most expensive neighborhood in South America and one of the few places in Rio de Janeiro without slums. The population is approximately 18,200. There is a 7.5-kilometer long cicleway and many parks around the lagoon.

Liaobu Town, located in the central part of Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China, is a town under its jurisdiction. It is adjacent to the urban area and is located next to the Songshan Lake High-tech Industrial Development Zone. With an area of 87.5 square kilometers, it is a famous IT and export powerhouse. In 2019, it ranked 22nd among China's top 100 towns. Liaobu has a long history, which was established during the Zhenguan period of the Tang Dynasty and has a history of more than 1,300 years. As early as the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the famous "Guangdong Fragrance" was distributed here, and it was known as the "Fragrance Market", and it was known as one of the "Four Famous Markets in Guangdong" along with Guangzhou Flower Market, Lianzhou Pearl Market, and Luofu Medicine Market.

Changbin Township is located on the mid-coastal terrace of HuaDong, and it is the northernmost township of Taitung County. It is bordered by Fengbin Township of Hualien County to the north, Chenggong Town to the south, the Pacific Ocean to the east, and the Coastal Mountain Range, Yuli Town of Hualien County, and Fuli Township to the west. The total land area of the whole township is 155.1868 square kilometers, accounting for about 4.41% of the county's total area. The administrative region is long and narrow from north to south, with a length of about 28 kilometers from north to south and a width of about 8 kilometers from east to west.

Xixian New Area is located in the central position of mainland China; the origin of the land of the People's Republic of China is located in Yongle Town, Jingyang County within the new area, which is the geographical center of China. The new area is 10 kilometers east of the center of Xi'an city and 3 kilometers west of the center of Xianyang city; the planned scope starts from Maoling and the mouth of the Lao River into the Wei River in the west, to the Baomao Expressway in the east, to the planned Xixian ring line in the north, and to the Beijing-Kunming Expressway in the south; the total area is 882 square kilometers, of which the planned construction land is 272 square kilometers. There are three rivers, the Wei River, Jing River, and Feng River, flowing through the new area, with a rich water system.
Chang'an Township is a township-level administrative unit under Gujiao City, Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China.

The old city of Cangzhou, located in the old state of Cangzhou city, Hebei province, China, is a national key cultural relics protection unit of Cang County, Cangzhou city. The type is ancient ruins, and the announcement time is May 2013. The historical era of the old city of Cangzhou is the Song Dynasty.

relation.head: the old state of Cangzhou city, Hebei province, China

input: Wandong refers to the eastern part of Anhui Province, in a narrow sense, it refers to Tianchang City embedded in Jiangsu Province; in a broad sense, it includes cities like Chuzhou and Ma'anshan.

Jiao Island, formerly known as Dongjiang and Pi Island, is an island to the east of the Yalu River estuary. It forms a tripod with Zhanzi Island and Lu Island at the mouth of the Yalu River. Geographically, it is located between the Liaodong Peninsula, the Korean Peninsula, and the Jiaodong Peninsula. Administratively, it is under the jurisdiction of Tieshan County, Pyonganbuk-do, Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Jiao Island is about 15 li from east to west and 10 li from north to south. During the Qing army's entry into the pass, it was known as "Pi Island" and was a stronghold of the Ming army led by Mao Wenlong.

In the past, Kepong gave people the impression of being remote and inconvenient to access. Therefore, from the 1980s to the 1990s, it once entered a period of development stagnation. With the successive opening of the Bandar Sri Damansara-Puchong Highway leading to Petaling Jaya and the Kuala Lumpur Second Ring Road  to Cheras, the related problems have basically been solved. Moreover, with the construction of the 12 Putrajaya Line, the convenience of Kepong to other areas has greatly increased.

Orakzai District is a special district of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It borders Khyber District to the north and Hangu County to the south. The total area is 1800km², with a total population of 450,000.

Alvdal (Norwegian: Alvdal) is a municipality in Norway, located in the Inland County, with Alvdal village as its administrative center. The municipality covers an area of 943 square kilometers, with a population of 2,424 people (as of 2018), and a population density of 2.6 people per square kilometer.

The list of rivers in Liaoning, enumerates all or part of the rivers within the territory of Liaoning Province, and is arranged according to the basin; the tributaries are sorted from the estuary to the source. There are more than 390 rivers of various sizes in Liaoning Province, with a total length of about 160,000 kilometers. The larger rivers include the Liao River, Hun River, Daling River, Taizi River, Raoyang River, and the Yalu River on the border between China and North Korea, forming the main water system of the province. Among them, the largest Liao River is listed as one of the seven major water systems in the country, and the rest of the rivers are collectively referred to as "Liaoning Coastal Rivers". Most of the rivers in the territory converge from the east, west, and north to the central and southern parts and flow into the Bohai Sea.

According to the statistics of the Taimali Household Registration Office in Taitung County, by the end of 2022, the number of households in Jinfeng Township was about 1.2 thousand, and the population was about 3.7 thousand. The villages with the most and least population in the township are Jialan Village and Binmao Village, respectively, with populations of 1,548 and 383 at the end of 2022.

The Roman Catholic Diocese of Ajaccio is a diocese of the Roman Catholic Church in France, belonging to the Archdiocese of Marseille. The diocese covers the entire island of Corsica, with 258,200 parishioners  in 2012, 434 parishes, and seventy-one priests. The current bishop of the diocese is Olivier de Germay. Traditionally, the diocese was established in the 3rd century and originally belonged to the Archdiocese of Pisa. After the signing of the Concordat in 1801, it became the only diocese on the island and was transferred to the jurisdiction of the Archdiocese of Aix.

input: Bajaur District, a special district of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Pakistan. The total area is 1,290km2, and the total population is 595,227 . The county seat is located in Khar. Bajaur is located on the border between Pakistan and Afghanistan, and was a key point from Kabul to Pakistan before the Khyber Pass was used. The main residents of this area are the Tarkani tribe of the Pashtuns .

Gran Sabana is a region located in the southeast of Venezuela. It includes the Guiana Highlands, the southeast of Bolivar State, and further extends to Brazil and Guyana. Its area is 10,820 square kilometers. A part of it is Venezuela's second largest national park - Canaima National Park. The average annual temperature is 20°C, and the average night temperature can reach 13°C. Gran Sabana has a rich geographical form, with rivers, waterfalls, canyons, valleys, dense forests and sparse grasslands. There are a large number of local unique plants and animals.

The Division of Gippsland, a lower house district in Victoria, Australia, is located in the eastern part of the Gippsland region, named after the region. It covers an area of 33,264 square kilometers. The district was established in 1900 and is one of the seventy-five original congressional districts. Since 1922, this district has been a safe district for the Country Party-National Party, and the Labor Party has never won in this district. The current district representative since 2008 is Darren Chester.

Denbighshire (Welsh: Sir Ddinbych, English: Denbighshire), is a county in Wales, UK. The total area is 844km², and the total population is 97,000 (estimated in 2007). The economy is mainly based on agriculture and tourism. The administrative center is in Ruthin, and the largest city is Rhyl.

The Luxembourg region became part of the Ostrogothic region under the Merovingian dynasty around 480, eventually becoming the core territory of the Carolingian Empire. In 843, the Treaty of Verdun granted Luxembourg and other lowland countries to Lothair I of the Middle Frankish Kingdom, but after the death of Lothair I in 855, it was granted to Lothair II, becoming part of the Kingdom of Lotharingia. Finally, in 959, Bruno I split the Kingdom of Lotharingia into two, and the Luxembourg region was divided into the Duchy of Lower Lorraine, under the Holy Roman Empire.
Ntcheu, is a town in the Central Region of Malawi, the administrative center of Ntcheu District. The local Irish potatoes are the most famous.

The Changshan Islands are located in the Yellow Sea on the east side of the Liaodong Peninsula, and are the northernmost islands in China. They are composed of 134 islands and several reefs, usually divided into three parts: the Outer Changshan Archipelago, the Inner Changshan Archipelago, and the Shicheng Archipelago. Except for the Shicheng Archipelago, which is under the jurisdiction of Zhuanghe City, the rest of the islands belong to Changhai County, which is also the only island county in the northeastern region of China. The island area is 170 square kilometers, with the largest being Dachangshan Island . It was once occupied by Japan and was reclaimed by China in 1945. The nearby sea is rich in fish.

Shenyuan County is bordered by Laojie Province's Wenpan County and Anpei Province's Mujiangjie County to the east, Shanluo Province's Qiongya County to the west, Shanluo Province's Mangluo County to the south, and Xinyuan County to the north.

Shuangliu District is a district under the jurisdiction of Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, China, located in the southern part of Chengdu. It is the center of Chengdu's southward development and an important part of Tianfu New Area. It is a national civilized city and one of the top 100 counties in the country. Originally known as Shuangliu County, it was officially approved for establishment on December 3, 2015, and was inaugurated in January 2016, and officially established on March 1, 2016.

Dera Ismail Khan County, a county in the southern part of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. It borders South Waziristan to the west, Tank County and Lakki Marwat County to the north, and Punjab Province to the east. The total area is 7,326 square kilometers, and the total population is 852,995 .

The Xia Longtou Longgang Site, located in Xia Longtou Village, Daduling Township, Tonghua County, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is an ancient site, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Tonghua County Cultural Relics and Culture Market Management Office. The historical era of the Xia Longtou Longgang Site is from the Bronze Age to the Tang Dynasty.

Paxos Island, also translated as Paxos Island, is one of the seven main islands of the Ionian Islands in western Greece. It has an area of 30.121km2 and a population of 2,438 . In Greek mythology, Poseidon struck Corfu Island with his trident to give his wife Amphitrite some tranquility, thus creating Paxos Island.

Monzón is a town in the province of Huesca, in the autonomous community of Aragon, Spain, with a population of 17,050. Monzón is the birthplace of Conchita Martínez. Richelieu once signed a treaty here with Gaspar de Guzmán, Count Duke of Olivares. This place was once the capital of the Kingdom of Aragon.

Mount Tahan , standing at 2187 meters, is the highest peak on the Malay Peninsula. It is located in the National Park of Pahang State, Malaysia, and is part of the Tahan Mountain Range. In Malay, "Gunung" means "mountain", and "Tahan" means "endurance". As the name suggests, this is a peak that requires a certain amount of stamina to climb, and is therefore considered one of the most difficult peaks to climb on the Malay Peninsula.
Spanish Guinea was a former colony of the Spanish Empire in Africa, which became Equatorial Guinea after gaining independence in 1968.

The Division of Chisholm, also known as the Chisholm electorate, is a lower house electorate in Victoria, Australia, located in the eastern suburbs of Melbourne, covering an area of 65 square kilometers. The current member belongs to the Australian Labor Party.
Sant Julia de Loria is a parish in Andorra, located at the southernmost part of Andorra, adjacent to the capital city of Andorra, Escaldes-Engordany, and the autonomous region of Catalonia in Spain.

San Vicente de Chucurí is a town in Colombia, located in the northeast of the country, governed by the Santander Province, 87 kilometers away from the capital Bucaramanga, with an area of 1,195 square kilometers, an altitude of 693 meters, and a population of 32,533 in 2005.

The plains of South America are vast, from north to south there are the Orinoco Plains, the Amazon Plains, and the La Plata Plains, which are the main areas for agricultural development. Due to the low population density in South America, except for Chile, most of the arable land in South America is idle, with a very low utilization rate. The planting industry is dominated by cash crops, which are the world's main producers of coffee, bananas, and sugarcane, and soybeans, wheat, rice, corn, cocoa, citrus, beef, etc., also account for most of the world's production. However, South America's grain crop production is insufficient for self-sufficiency, and most countries need to import grain.

The province of South Ilocos is located on the west coast of the northern part of Luzon Island. To the north of South Ilocos Province is North Ilocos Province, to the northeast is Abra Province, to the east is Mountain Province, to the south is La Union Province, to the southeast is Benguet Province of the Cordillera Administrative Region, and to the west is the South China Sea. It covers an area of 2,579.58 square kilometers, accounting for 20.11% of the total land area of the first district. The terrain varies in wave-like undulations, with altitudes ranging from 10 meters to 1700 meters.

The Araucanía Region is the 12th region from north to south in Chile. The capital is Temuco. About one-third of the population in this region are Mapuche people, which is the highest proportion among all regions in Chile. During the period from 1900 to 1930, despite the economic recession in other parts of Chile, the population of Araucanía also grew significantly. Araucanía subsequently became one of the main agricultural areas in Chile, known as the "Granary of Chile". The administrative region of Araucanía was established in 1974, located in the core of the larger historical area of Araucanía.

The Frontier Region Dera Ismail Khan (English: Frontier Region Dera Ismail Khan) is a frontier region of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Pakistan. The region is named after the neighboring Dera Ismail Khan County. It borders South Waziristan to the north, Dera Ghazi Khan County and Afghanistan to the south, and Zobe County to the west. The frontier region is managed by the county coordinator of Dera Ismail Khan County.

Tanhualin is a street in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, China. It gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in the fourth year of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty , located in the north of the ancient city of Wuchang, running from east to west, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west, between Huayuan Mountain and Crab Cape Mountain, with a total length of 1221.23 meters. There are alleys such as Goujiaying on both sides of the street.

Redcar and Cleveland is a unitary authority area in the ceremonial county of North Yorkshire, England. The main cities are Redcar, Saltburn-by-the-Sea, and Guisborough. The population was 139,132 in 2001. It is part of the Tees Valley economic area.
The Chubu region is located in the central part of Honshu, Japan, and is one of the eight major regions of Japan. The largest city is Nagoya.

Tempio Pausania is a town in the province of Sassari in the northern part of the Sardinia region of Italy, with a population of 14,000. It was once the administrative center of the former province of Olbia-Tempio. It is famous for its grape production.
Saint-Maur is a commune in the Seine-et-Marne department of France, belonging to the Mo city district.

Santa Cruz de Mompox (Spanish: Santa Cruz de Mompox) is a town in Colombia, located in the north of the country, under the jurisdiction of the Bolivar Province, 249 kilometers away from the capital Cartagena. It was founded on May 3, 1537, with an area of 645.37 square kilometers, an altitude of 10 meters, and a population of 41,565 in 2005.

Xinhuo County is bordered by Fengshou County and Yunnan Province of China to the north, Shanluo Province's Qiongya County, Dianbian Province's Duozuo County, Mengcha County, and Manglai City to the south, Xinyuan County, Santang County, and Laizhou City to the east, and Nanrun County to the west.

Weeki Wachee (English: Weeki Wachee) is a city under Hernando County in the state of Florida, United States. It was established in 1966. The area is about 2.7 square kilometers (approximately 1 square mile). According to the 2010 U.S. Census, the city has a population of 12. It ranks 409th in the state in terms of population.

Quindalup (English: Quindalup) is a small town located in the southwest region of Western Australia, Australia. Quindalup is located on Geographe Bay and is located next to the Caves Road connecting Busselton and Dunsborough. According to the 2006 census, Quindalup has a population of 1,015. Quindalup's nickname is "Southern Jewel".

input: Tropoja (in Albanian: Tropoja) is a city in Albania. Tropoja is located in the Tropoja district of the Kukës County in northern Albania.

Antsirabe is the third largest city in Madagascar, the capital of the Vakinankaratra region, with a population of 183,000. Antsirabe is 1,500m above sea level, so compared to most areas of Madagascar and the African continent, the temperature is relatively cool. Antsirabe is the terminus of the Tananarive-Antsirabe railway, currently only used as a freight line. There are also warm springs locally, providing hot spring baths, which were most famous in the 19th century.
Mopti is a city in Mali, located at the confluence of the Niger River and the Bani River, between Timbuktu and Segou.

The Candlemas Islands (English: Candlemas Islands) are a group of islands in the Atlantic Ocean, part of the South Sandwich Islands, composed of Candlemas Island and Vindication Island. Administratively, they are managed by the British Overseas Territory of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, and there are no inhabitants on the islands.
